description: AD-49 cutover allowlist. DNI-490 filled it with the R14 remnants (the five deny-all firestore.rules matches and the streak_events and learning_order indexes) and switched CI to --enforce; the release after (DNI-491) removed those remnants and emptied it. It stays empty: a retired name anywhere the gate scans fails CI. Each entry is {symbol, path, count, reason, owner?}; count is the exact number of hits allowed.
